messages:
maya: Hey team — I'm onboarding and hitting a blocker with my first CI run. Followed the onboarding doc, installed the Buildkite agent, and triggered the pipeline but it fails on auth. Anyone who can point me to what I'm missing?

sam: Welcome maya! Can you paste the error and the pipeline link?

maya: Pipeline: https://buildkite.com/redwood/first-week-templates/builds/153
Error snippet: 
```
2026-03-20T14:12:01Z ERROR auth: failed to fetch token: 403 Forbidden
Caused by: oauth: insufficient_scope
```

alex: Looks like GitHub App token scopes. Did you install the Redwood CI GitHub App on your fork/org?

maya: I clicked the install link during setup but I think I only granted repo access to my personal repo, not the org. Where do I check the scopes?

sam: In the org settings -> Applications -> Installed GitHub Apps -> Redwood CI -> Configure -> Repository access. It should be set to 'All repositories' or the specific repo. Also the App needs the "Contents: Read & write" and "Deployments" permission for some workflows.

mel: Also check that the GitHub App has permission to create workflow dispatch and access secrets if your pipeline reads secrets from the org. That 403 often means the app's token doesn't have the right scope for the API your pipeline calls.

buildkite-bot: Buildkite build #153 failed: Job 'ci:unit-tests' exited with status 1. See logs: https://logs.buildkite.com/redwood/153/jobs/7

maya: Thanks — I changed the app to the org but build still failing with a different error now: 
```
ERR: buildkite-agent: failed to register agent: 401 Unauthorized - token revoked
```

alex: Ah, token revoked usually means the agent token used on the machine is invalid. Did you use the token from the onboarding doc or from the agent registration page?

maya: I grabbed the token from the onboarding Slack DM (old). Should I regenerate?

sam: Yep — go to Buildkite -> Teams -> Agents -> Create a new agent token (ensure scope 'agent' checked). Then on the host run `sudo systemctl restart buildkite-agent` after updating /etc/buildkite-agent/buildkite-agent.cfg with `token="<new-token>"`.

mel: If you're on mac, run `launchctl unload && launchctl load` for the agent launchd plist. Also watch out for IAM rotation policies — infra rotates tokens weekly, so grab the token after you join and don't reuse an old one.

maya: Regenerated token, restarted agent. Build retriggering...

infra-bot: Notice: GitHub App installation changed by @alex — org-access granted to 'redwood' for 'Redwood CI'.

buildkite-bot: Buildkite build #154 started: https://buildkite.com/redwood/first-week-templates/builds/154

maya: Build passed! :tada: Thanks everyone, especially alex and sam for the perms walkthrough. Quick question: who do I ping for future token rotations or if my access disappears?

sam: Ping #eng-infra and @mel for infra token lifecycle. We'll also add you to the agent rotation doc.

mel: I'll add maya to the oncall rota and link the rotation playbook. Welcome again! :wave:
